TITLE: Auto-moderation

LOG_CHANNEL.LABEL: Log Channel
LOG_CHANNEL.HELP: The channel where AutoMod logs will be sent

MAX_STRIKES.LABEL: Maximum Strikes
MAX_STRIKES.HELP: Number of strikes before a user is punished

ACTION.LABEL: Action on Max Strikes
ACTION.HELP: The action to take when a user reaches the maximum number of strikes

ACTION_DURATION.LABEL: Timeout duration (minutes)
ACTION_DURATION.HELP: How long the timeout lasts once the maximum strike count is reached. Only relevant for the “Timeout” action. At most 40320 minutes (28 days) — Discord allows no more. Escalation levels carry their own duration and take precedence.

DEBUG_MODE.LABEL: Debug mode
DEBUG_MODE.HELP: Also moderates moderators and admins — they are exempt otherwise. For testing filters with your own account.

ANTI_GHOSTPING.LABEL: Anti Ghost-Ping
ANTI_GHOSTPING.HELP: Logs deleted messages containing mentions to the log channel. Requires a log channel and only covers messages still in the bot's cache. It only logs, it does not punish.

ANTI_SPAM.LABEL: Anti-Spam
ANTI_SPAM.HELP: Deletes messages when someone posts too fast or repeats the same message. Thresholds below.

ANTI_SPAM_MESSAGES.LABEL: Messages
ANTI_SPAM_MESSAGES.HELP: This many messages within the window counts as flooding

ANTI_SPAM_SECONDS.LABEL: Window (seconds)
ANTI_SPAM_SECONDS.HELP: Messages are counted within this window

ANTI_SPAM_DUPLICATES.LABEL: Identical messages
ANTI_SPAM_DUPLICATES.HELP: This many identical messages in a row — counted across channels

ANTI_MASSMENTION_THRESHOLD.LABEL: Mass-Mention Threshold
ANTI_MASSMENTION_THRESHOLD.HELP: Number of mentions before a message is considered mass-mention

ANTI_ATTACHMENTS.LABEL: Anti-Attachments
ANTI_ATTACHMENTS.HELP: Automatically delete messages with file attachments

ANTI_INVITES.LABEL: Anti-Invites
ANTI_INVITES.HELP: Deletes messages containing Discord invites. Works independently of Anti-Links — an invite always counts as an invite, not as a link.

ANTI_LINKS.LABEL: Anti-Links
ANTI_LINKS.HELP: Deletes messages containing links. Discord invites are excluded; Anti-Invites handles those.

MAX_LINES.LABEL: Maximum Lines
MAX_LINES.HELP: Delete messages with more lines (0 = disabled)

WHITELISTED_CHANNELS.LABEL: Whitelisted Channels
WHITELISTED_CHANNELS.HELP: Channels where AutoMod is not active (Ctrl+Click for multi-select)

INFO.TITLE: Info
INFO.DESC: AutoMod protects your server from spam, unwanted links and mass mentions.

STEP1.TITLE: 1. Setup Log Channel
STEP1.DESC: Select a channel where AutoMod logs should appear

STEP2.TITLE: 2. Configure Strike System
STEP2.DESC: Set how many strikes a user can receive before being punished

STEP3.TITLE: 3. Enable Anti Features
STEP3.DESC: Activate desired protection features (Anti-Spam, Anti-Links, etc.)

STEP4.TITLE: 4. Adjust Limits
STEP4.DESC: Optional: Set limits for line length and mentions

TIP.TITLE: 💡 Tip
TIP.DESC: Enable Debug Mode to test settings without affecting moderators

SETTINGS.SUBTITLE: The basics: where things are logged and what happens on too many strikes
SETTINGS.MORE_DESC: Filters, rules and the log have their own pages in the AutoMod area.

DM_MESSAGE.LABEL: Custom direct message
DM_MESSAGE.HELP: Replaces the default text entirely. Without placeholders it contains no strike counts — the total is always shown as a separate field below.

WHITELIST.TITLE: Whitelisting
WHITELIST.SUBTITLE: Exceptions & Exemptions
WHITELIST.ROLE_WHITELIST_DESC: Coming soon: Exclude specific roles from AutoMod (e.g. Moderators, Trusted Members)

RAID.TITLE: Raid Protection
RAID.SUBTITLE: Raid Protection & Join Spam
RAID.FEATURE_1: Join Spam Detection (X users in Y seconds)

COMPOUND.TITLE: Compound Rules
COMPOUND.SUBTITLE: Create rules that combine multiple conditions

LOGS_DESC: The channel where the bot has to send automod logs
STRIKES_DESC: The maximum amount of strikes a user can have before being punished
ACTION_DESC: The action to take when a user reaches the max amount of strikes
LOG_EMBED_DESC: The color of the embeds sent in the logs channel
DM_EMBED_DESC: The color of the embeds sent in the DMs of the punished user
WHITELIST_CH_DESC: The channels where the bot won't moderate
DEBUG_DESC: Skip moderating messages sent by moderators
INVITES_DESC: Automatically delete messages with discord invites
SPAM_DESC: Automatically delete messages that are considered spam
MASSMENTION_DESC: Automatically moderate messages with mass mentions
MASSMENTION_THRES_DESC: The amount of mentions a message must have to be considered a mass mention
MAXLINES_DESC: Automatically delete messages with more than the specified amount of lines

COMPOUND.NAME: Rule Name
COMPOUND.EMPTY: No compound rules found. Create your first rule above.
COMPOUND.TIP_TEXT: Compound rules allow you to combine multiple conditions. E.g. 'Account younger than 7 days AND message contains link' → Timeout.
COMPOUND.CONFIRM_DELETE: Do you really want to delete this compound rule?

DASHBOARD.SUBTITLE: What AutoMod is doing and what it did last
DASHBOARD.LOCKDOWN_HINT: The server is locked down. The lockdown has to be lifted by hand — use /automod unlock.
DASHBOARD.NO_RECENT_HINT: Once AutoMod steps in, it shows up here.

FILTER.SUBTITLE: Which content AutoMod objects to, and from what amount
FILTER.ZERO_MEANS_OFF: A value of 0 turns the limit off.

RULES.SUBTITLE: Keyword lists, custom patterns and combined conditions

KEYWORDS.TITLE: Keyword lists
KEYWORDS.DESC: Enable prepared word lists. Messages that match are deleted and earn a strike.
KEYWORDS.NONE: No keyword lists found. The JSON files are missing from the bot directory.

REGEX.TITLE: Custom patterns
REGEX.DESC: Your own regex filters for special cases. Every pattern is checked for ReDoS exposure before it is saved.
REGEX.NAME: Name

ESCALATION.SUBTITLE: Graduated responses based on the number of strikes
ESCALATION.THRESHOLD_HELP: The level applies from this count upwards.
ESCALATION.EMPTY_HINT: Without levels the action from the basic settings applies.
ESCALATION.TIP: The highest level whose threshold is reached wins. With 5 strikes and levels 3 and 5, level 5 applies.

EXEMPTIONS.SUBTITLE: Who and what AutoMod leaves alone
EXEMPTIONS.ROLES_DESC: Members holding one of these roles are not checked.
EXEMPTIONS.CHANNELS_DESC: AutoMod does not act in these channels at all.

RAID.LOCKDOWN_HINT: The lockdown stays in place until it is lifted by hand.
RAID.ENABLE_HELP: Guards against join waves and very young accounts.
RAID.JOIN_THRESHOLD_HELP: This many joins within the window counts as a raid.
RAID.MIN_ACCOUNT_AGE_HELP: Younger accounts are turned away. 0 disables the check.
RAID.ACTION_HELP: Kick runs automatically; ban is meant for manual follow-up.
RAID.LOCKDOWN_HELP: Raises verification and removes @everyone write access.
RAID.ALERT_MENTION_MODS_HELP: Mentions the moderation roles in the warning.
RAID.TRUSTED_INVITES_HELP: One invite code per line. Anyone joining through these is not covered by raid protection. Enter the code only, not the full address.
RAID.EVENTS_EMPTY: No raid events recorded so far.

LOGS.SUBTITLE: What AutoMod actually did
LOGS.CLEANUP_HINT: Deletes violations and raid events older than the given age. This cannot be undone.
LOGS.EMPTY_HINT: Either there was nothing to do, or AutoMod is not armed yet.

JS.STANDARD_ESKALATION: Create default levels? Existing levels are kept.
JS.KOMBI_UNVOLLSTAENDIG: Name and at least one condition are required.
JS.AUFRAEUMEN_FRAGE: Permanently delete entries older than {tage} days?
